data.name: Anuja
data.gender_notes: Anuja is used as a unisex name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Sanskrit word 'anuja' which means 'leader' or 'graceful one'. In Hindu mythology, Anuja is a name of Lakshmi, the goddess of wealth and prosperity. The name Anuja carries the meaning “Graceful, pleasing” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Anuja usually hope their child will grow to embody graceful, pleasing and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbolizes the grace and leadership qualities of the goddess Lakshmi.
data.etymology: Anuja belongs to the Sanskrit linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Graceful, pleasing.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Anuja total 2, giving a life-path number of 2. Number 2 is linked with Moon and with the qualities of harmony, sensitivity and partnership.

historical_references.reference: Anuja is mentioned in the Hindu epic Mahabharata, as the name of the queen of King Shantanu and the mother of Bhishma, who was conceived after the king saw the god Shiva in the form of a beautiful woman.

Anuja is also the name of a goddess in the Hindu pantheon, described as the goddess of prosperity, wealth, and good fortune. She is often depicted with four hands, holding symbols of prosperity, and is sometimes identified with the goddess Lakshmi.
